title: [CmdPal] Add tabbed pages to Command Palette

status.label: Fork-only navigation regression
status.detail: The fork review remains Copilot-clean, but proper Visual Studio validation exposed 10 failures in ListViewModelNavigationTests. The same pinned upstream head passes all 26 tests, proving a fork-only behavioral regression rather than an environment failure.

next_action: Fix the fork-only stale/recovery fetch, recovery-phase, deferred-publication, and cancellation regressions; rerun the focused tests and affected builds; then request one fresh Copilot review and map every remaining fork-only delta to the upstream diff.

fork_head.details: Visual Studio MSBuild succeeded. TabbedPageViewModelTests passed 18/18, but ListViewModelNavigationTests passed only 16/26. The pinned upstream head passed 26/26 under the same environment, so the 10 failures are fork-only regressions involving stale/recovery fetch counts, recovery phase tracking, deferred publication, and cancellation handling.

upstream_head.details: Build essentials, serial Visual Studio rebuilds for ViewModels, UI, and focused tests passed; baseline ListViewModelNavigationTests passed 26/26.

upstream_safety.detail: No public mutation was made to microsoft/PowerToys.
